description: This file defines a Java interface named MerchantConfigurationDao, which provides data access methods for MerchantConfiguration entities related to merchant stores. It extends a generic DAO interface and includes methods for retrieving configurations by key, store, and type.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific merchant configuration by key and store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves all configurations for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists configurations filtered by type and store.
